description:
## Why
drive_test.rs was meant to test the fact-engine drive machinery (scheduler, jobs, waits, demand, pull sessions, wakes, settlement) and grew into general compiler tests. After homing, by census subject roughly: semantic 72, drive-machinery 18 (+62 mixed), native 44, lowering 23, backend 15, source 6, transport 3, runtime 3.

## What changes
Structural tests move to per-stage files, joining existing single-subject homes (macro_product_test.rs for source, semantic_analysis_test.rs for semantic). drive_test.rs and product_drive_test.rs (30/38 drive-machinery) keep drive machinery and may merge.

## Signal
Every test in drive_test.rs has subject drive-machinery.
title: Split drive_test.rs by stage; it keeps only drive machinery
